column3: With respect to the Setna Industrial Portfolio Mortgage Loan (4.6%), approximately 13.5% of the net rentable area at the entire Mortgaged Property is used as office space. In addition and separately from the foregoing, the second floor of the 475 Bond Street individual Mortgaged Property, consisting of approximately 25,000 square feet, is intended to be used as office space but is currently in shell condition.
